caveats: Region contains 3600 grid cells (60x60); 3304 are sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days) and 296 are land cells, set to 0 in the mask. SST analysed in kelvin as stored. Thresholds: 90th percentile (hazen quantile) of the per-day-of-year pool (121 values from baseline 1992-2002 with +/-5 calendar-day windows, including 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05); day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61 for both threshold and climatology; both then smoothed with a 31-day circular moving mean. Per-cell MHWs: runs of >=5 consecutive hot days (SST >= smoothed threshold) merged across gaps of <=2 non-hot days, gap days included. One regional event found: 2016-06-01 to 2016-06-18; no active days in the rest of the target period.
